provenance: Split from wq#3944/A4, design/wq3929_competitive_analysis.md section 5 A4 (reverse-skill scenario routing), design/wq3806_limpet_architecture.md:152-159 (two-level router tool budget). Every tool id below must resolve by name in limpet/tool-catalog.json; stage order is the dispatch order the Target Device Wizard identify step and the meta-server's on-demand expansion should offer the agent.

rockchip-firmware.description: Rockchip SoC firmware images and maskrom/loader boot streams (RK3xxx update.img/loader, recovery partitions).

android-apk.description: Android application packages (APK/DEX) and on-device live inspection via ADB.

elf-arm.description: Standalone ARM ELF binaries (userland or kernel modules) outside a recognized firmware container.

pcap.description: Captured network traffic for undocumented wire-protocol inference.

uefi.description: UEFI firmware volumes and images (PI firmware, DXE drivers, capsules).
